camera.setups: virtual documentary camera: slow pans down from the surface into a cut-away, push-ins on parts, pull-outs to maps; feels like one continuous take
camera.gear_guess: motion-graphics / 3D render (Blender or After Effects style), composited with photos and text clippings

lighting.lighting_overall: soft, low-key, top-left light on rendered objects; night and dusk scenes at the surface

grade.grade_overall: desaturated near-neutral greys with a slight cool tint, warm muted earth for soil and rust, one warm amber accent for pressure and flow; photos in black and white

editing.editing: about 27 changes a minute but most are camera moves inside one cut-away; hard cuts to clippings, maps and photos; pops and dings on text and photo appearances

format.format: 9:16 sourced documentary explainer, 130 s, one TTS narrator, no music bed, words at the top, picture in a central band, small print below

style.render_style: sourced documentary cut-away: semi-realistic soft-shaded renders (machines, rock grains, a car interior) and flat cut-away cross-sections of ground layers inside a central picture band (y 27 to 76% of the frame), with real black-and-white photos pinned in paper frames and paper clippings of source sentences
style.outline: no outlines; hair-line darker edges where surfaces meet; thin white leader lines from labels
style.shading: soft gradients from top-left light on rendered objects; strata as banded greys with fine horizontal streaks; glossy highlights on liquids
style.shape_language: horizontal layers, thin straight pipes and curves, angular mineral grains, rounded machine housings
style.texture: fine horizontal streaks in rock layers, speckle for granular rock, faint grid on the black top and bottom bands
style.type_ui: top caption: words appear one at a time, said words grey, newest white bold, one keyword in a blue text-selection box with two round handles; uppercase bold small-caps labels with leader lines; big white numbers with small units; serif text on paper clippings with an underline; small grey print for credits, sources and honesty notes (Cut-away view, illustration; Time compressed; Not to scale)
style.motion_style: calm and continuous: slow pans and push-ins, lines growing, cracks spreading, flow dots, evidence rising in on its word; no bounce
style.signature: every claim carries evidence on screen: a credited real photo, a clipping of the source sentence, and honest small print about what kind of picture it is
style.do_not_copy: the topic (oil extraction by fracking), its machines and places, its numbers and years, the source names and the patent figure; no handle or watermark seen

story.summary: A sourced explainer that corrects a common picture of an industry: the resource is not in an underground lake but locked in rock, then walks through the real steps of getting it out in order, with a scale number early, a turn to a side effect late, and a callback to the opening picture plus a share line.
story.hook: 0-6 s: the familiar machine, the misconception drawn as a lake outline under it, then the truth in magnified grains; 6.8 s the question "So how do you get it out of a rock?"; 9-15 s a three-verb preview of the steps.
highlights: 16-19 s: the scale number with its year, proved by a clipping of the source sentence over a map
20-25 s: "Imagine you are driving through [real place]" puts the viewer in the real location
31-102 s: the procedure in real order, "First, ...", each part labelled and proved by a credited photo or a quoted sentence
102-120 s: the turn: a side effect, with a survey statistic
120-130 s: callback to the opening machine and a share line
